title: Learning from Demonstration for Complex Tasks: Vision-Language-Action Models for OARbot Control
text:
0.1 Project schedule
This site has two halves. The thesis is the prose in Background, Methods, Operations, and Future Work — that’s what gets bound. The rest of the site is the project-management surface the thesis runs on: a top-level Gantt, the initiative board below, a weekly-update log, and an archive of source material.
Top-level Gantt covering the work categories the advisor tracks. The Mermaid block below is the single source of truth for the schedule. Edit this block when the schedule changes; the per-WU frozen PNGs (updates/WU-*/media/gantt.png) regenerate automatically from it via scripts/render/build_gantt.py. Add a bar here whenever you scaffold a new epic (.\thesis.ps1 new epic …).

0.4 Where to go from here

Reading the thesis — start with Background and use the sidebar.
Reviewing weekly progress — see the weekly updates appendix (newest first).
Browsing the project tree — see the initiatives appendix; each initiative lists its epics, each epic lists its items + status log.
Looking up source material — see the archive appendix, with an external index for files too large to carry in git.
